claim: For periscope, main and agentsview are upstream mirrors while merged is the only agent integration base; a rewrite recovery must preserve both mirror parents and the proven merged tree.

decisions.notes: Verified during the 2026-07-28 post-expunge repair: main was tree-identical to latentsignal-org/periscope, agentsview was synced to kenn-io/agentsview, and merged required a dual-pedigree anchor rather than a single-lineage rebase.
